With Amazon’s Black Friday Sale going strong, you can currently find a wide variety of tool deals from various brands. There’s six Greenworks Cordless Snow Blower and Snow Shovel low prices starting from $178 , for example, which are a great opportunity ahead of winter officially arriving. There’s also the massive Worx tool roundup with up to 45% savings from $29 , the Segway Navimow robot lawn mower lows from $849 , and also the best EGO Power+ snow blower prices of 2026 from $699 . All these and more can be found within our Black Friday Green Deals hub .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
These six Greenworks cordless snow blower and snow shovel kits are at their best prices for Black Friday from $178
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday savings event , you can currently find the best prices of the year on six Greenworks snow clearing solutions, like the 40V 16-inch Gen 2 Snow Blower with a 5.0Ah battery and fast charger down at $229.49 shipped . Down from $270, like most of the brand’s snow clearing tools, it’s been largely out of stock for a lot of the year, with the discounts we’ve seen having taken the costs down as low as $260. The deal here gives you $41 off the going rate, landing it at the best price we have tracked. You can find various other snow blower and snow shovel deals rounded up down below.
24V 12-inch Snow Shovel with 4.0Ah battery: $178 (Reg. $230)
48V (24V x 2) 12-inch Snow Shovel with 2x 4.0Ah batteries: $290 (Reg. $330)
80V 12-inch Snow Shovel with 2.5Ah battery: $300 (Reg. $360)
40V 16-inch Gen 2 Snow Blower with 5.0Ah battery: $229 (Reg. $270)
48V 16-inch Snow Blower with 2x 4.0Ah batteries: $300 (Reg. $390)
40V 20-inch Snow Blower with 5.0Ah battery: $357 (Reg. $420)
Save up to 45% on Worx tools during Amazon’s Black Friday Sale – deals start from $29
As part of Amazon’s ongoing Black Friday Sale event , you can currently bolster your Worx arsenal with up to 45% discounts across a wide variety of tools. There are plenty of notable deals, like the 20V 10-inch 2-in-1 Cordless Electric Chain and Pole Saw down at $123.49 shipped , in addition to this corded Trivac 3-in-1 Electric Leaf Blower, Vacuum, and Mulcher with a LeafPro collection system down at $67.99 shipped , and more.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
You can check out the massive lineup of Worx Black Friday tool deals here .
Segway’s Navimow i215 LiDAR robot mower drops to $1,329 low with Black Friday savings ($270 off), more from $849
Alongside the expanded Amazon Black Friday deals , so too has Segway expanded and increased its Navimow Black Friday robot savings to low prices. My top pick is the X4 Series models that are only getting a 2x points promotion (especially after going hands-on in my review ), with it otherwise being the i215 LiDAR Robot Lawn Mower down at $1,329 shipped , which is matching its Amazon pricing . Down from $1,599, we previously saw this model taken down to its second-lowest $1,399 rate in early savings, but now you’re getting a larger $270 markdown for the all-time low, matching its Prime Day pricing. Likewise, you can bundle the robot with a Garage M accessory for $1,578.99 shipped , which also matches at Amazon . You can find the rest of the brand’s deals down below starting from $849.
Segway Navimow’s fully expanded Black Friday offers:
i206 AWD robot: $849 (Reg. $999) | not available on Amazon
i210 AWD robot: $999 (Reg. $1,299) | matched at Amazon
i215 LiDAR robot: $1,329 (Reg. $1,599) | matched at Amazon
i215 LiDAR robot with garage bundle: $1,579 (Reg. $1,849) | matched at Amazon
X430 Robot Lawn Mower: $2,400 (No initial price cut) | matched at Amazon provides 2x reward points covers up to 1 acre per charge
X450 Robot Lawn Mower: $2,999 (No initial price cut) | not available at Amazon provides 2x reward points covers up to 1.5 acres per charge
And more…
Amazon’s best EGO snow blower deals are back at up to $220 off, cash in from $699
Amazon is currently offering a collection of deals for the best 2026 prices on EGO Power+ snow blowers , starting with the 56V 21-inch Single-Stage Cordless Snow Blower + 2x 4.0Ah batteries down at $699 shipped . Down from $749, this package has has only seen one previous discount to this same rate in 2026, with it otherwise keeping to its full price. The deal here gives you $50 savings so you can be prepared for winter at the best price of the year. We’ve got all the brand’s other snow clearing deals rounded up for you below.
EGO’s current snow-clearing deals:
21-inch Single-Stage Snow Blower + 2x 4.0Ah batteries: $699 (Reg. $750)
24-inch Two-Stage Snow Blower + 2x 6.0Ah batteries: $1,499 (Reg. $1,600)
24-inch Two-Stage Snow Blower + 2x 7.5Ah batteries: $1,599 (Reg. $1,750)
28-inch Two-Stage Snow Blower + 2x 12.0Ah batteries: $2,199 (Reg. $2,420)
